evidence.text: Singing 口 and beating drums 壴
樂也。从壴从口。凡喜之屬皆从喜。

Ideogrammic compound (會意 /会意): 壴 (“drum”) + 口 (“mouth”). It represents joy through playing the drum and singing cheerfully.
Duplicated character: 囍.
